name: eq-eguitar
description: Body, axis, and edge balanced per part. Clean, crunch, distortion, jazz, and metal directions.
notes: Precondition: Guitar track selected in Cubase, insert 0 loaded per opencode/reference/eq-eguitar.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Axis lift in the mid (~0.55); body / edge / low-cut manually by resolved title.
Dry by design: no send.set calls; study stays upfront.
